title: Modern E-Commerce Web Platform
shortDescription: A fully responsive, high-performance web storefront with dynamic cart, catalog filtering, and secure checkout architecture.
fullDescription: A modern, modular e-commerce solution engineered for seamless shopping experiences. Features rapid client-side product filtering, responsive state-driven shopping cart, authenticated order checkout mock flow, and an accessible interface designed with mobile-first CSS architecture.
features: Dynamic catalog searching and category filtering
Interactive cart with local storage persistence
Responsive layout optimized for smartphones and tablets
Accessible markup with WCAG 2.1 compliance

title: Business Analytics & Metrics Dashboard
shortDescription: Interactive data visualization platform rendering live telemetry, revenue KPIs, and real-time operational graphs.
fullDescription: A robust data analytics portal that processes metrics into clean, interactive charts and summaries. Built using Python data pipelines and interactive web components to provide immediate actionable business insights and security logging visualizations.
features: Real-time interactive Chart.js line and doughnut visualizations
Secure role-based views and modular analytics panels
Dynamic data filtering by date range, department, and severity
Optimized query aggregation for large operational datasets

title: Professional Developer Portfolio Template
shortDescription: A lightweight, modular, and JSON-driven personal portfolio framework with dark mode and zero runtime dependencies.
fullDescription: An architecturally clean developer website template created to showcase technical ability, projects, blog entries, and qualifications. Employs a pure vanilla JS data-driven philosophy with instant search, multi-category filters, and smooth micro-interactions.
features: 100% JSON-driven content management without database overhead
Dark and light theme toggle with persistent preferences
Accessible modal dialogues and keyboard navigation
Fast static delivery compatible with GitHub Pages

title: Secure Authentication & API Gateway
shortDescription: Cybersecurity-oriented backend service implementing JWT tokens, Argon2 hashing, rate limiting, and RBAC.
fullDescription: Engineered with web security and OWASP Top 10 prevention at its core. Features hardened authentication endpoints, brute-force throttling, input sanitization, CSRF token mitigation, and role-based access control.
features: Cryptographically secure token lifecycle and refresh token rotation
Sliding window rate-limiting middleware against brute-force attacks
Automated payload schema validation to block injection exploits
Comprehensive audit logging for access and security anomalies

title: Nexus UI Component & Design System
shortDescription: A comprehensive collection of accessible, modular UI elements and CSS micro-interactions for modern web applications.
fullDescription: A custom design system containing cards, modals, form controls, navigation elements, and interactive widgets. Built to provide consistent visual rhythm, strict color token semantics, and accessible keyboard focus across various devices.
features: Over 40+ atomic components and layout primitives
Strict CSS variable design token architecture
Tested for AAA contrast compliance and focus visibility
Smooth hardware-accelerated animations and hover states

title: Algorithmic Problem Solver & Console Suite
shortDescription: High-performance C++ and Python console application suite implementing core data structures and algorithmic utilities.
fullDescription: A collection of algorithmic implementations, graph traversal algorithms, encryption prototypes, and memory-efficient sorting suites written in C++ and Python during Computer Science undergraduate studies at Eastern University of Sri Lanka.
features: Optimized graph traversals (Dijkstra, BFS, DFS) with benchmark logs
Custom hash map and binary search tree implementations
Cryptographic hashing and cipher exploration modules
Clean object-oriented architecture and memory safety patterns
